EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.title: Emote Display Time
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.hover.desc:
How long every emote stays on screen.
Only affects your own screen.
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_PAGE_CLICKS.title: Reverse Page Click Direction
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_PAGE_CLICKS.hover.desc:
While the emote wheel is open, left click goes to the previous page and right click to the next one.
Turn this on to swap them.
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_VISIBILITY.title: Emotes on the Wheel
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_VISIBILITY_HINT.title: Click an emote to hide or show it on your wheel (the wheel closes the gaps). Other players' emotes are always shown. If every emote is hidden, all are shown.
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_ALL_EMOTES.title: Show All
EMOTEPLUS-HIDE_ALL_EMOTES.title: Hide All
